column25:
Ailey-affiliated teaching artists will teach four free workshops for all ages and abilities in community spaces around Boston. They will lead participants through excerpts from Mr. Ailey's iconic choreography surrounded by additional creative enrichment activities, such as fan-making workshops, gospel performances, and other activities developed in collaboration with more than ten different community organizations deeply embedded in workshop neighborhoods. Locations include Boston Renaissance Charter School in Hyde Park, Brooke Charter High School in Mattapan, the Roxbury YMCA, and ChezVous Roller Skating Rink in Dorchester – places where a large percentage of the residents identify as Black and African American.
